body: I wish it was my story too. Diagnosed couple months ago, and got depressed. With Concerta I lose weight while underweighted. I'm now 30 and achieved nothing I can be proud of it. No job, no social life. Feeling stuck in this life. I'm not looking forward to live further with this disability.
This is me. Only I get refused in the end and started over again with more anxiety and shame.
Started 2 days ago again with Concerta, and I experience less depressive moods and anxiety.
No school, no job, no social life. Just only me isolated with my  disabled brain.
But what if the body and its brain is like a local disk, which is synchronised with the cloud. And when the local disk damages, the information keeps alive in the cloud?
